initial_placement: migrate and restore a valid logical v3 or v4 QRect on its connected screen or center the preferred size on the active parent screen before first visibility
reposition_after_open: one decoration-only clamp when the decorated frame is outside the active screen; never move an already-contained frame
saved_geometry: versioned UI-only QSettings normal logical QRect plus screen identity available bounds and informational DPR; reject undersized offscreen disconnected and compact records
initial_grid_mount: parent every new field to its Settings card before showing or visibility filtering
rendered_previews: compact five-step calendar palette ramp and live Bible appearance preview only; no embedded dashboard preview
web_bridge_dispatch: deferred one event-loop turn and coalesced
active_dialog_reference: one temporary controller reference exists only during modal exec for re-entry routing and is cleared in finally
primary_prompts: stacked overlay children keep the Settings shell visible beneath a tokenized scrim and never create another window
auxiliary_dialogs: single-title 480-to-540 px event and verse editors are parented window-modal dialogs clamped to 80 percent of the Settings body; native file and color pickers remain parented
compact_navigation: single-line synchronized QTabBar whenever retaining the 184 px rail would leave less than 680 logical pixels for the main region; the 860 px supported minimum is compact
page_content: one vertical native scroll area owns each page body; only the bounded five-row Events list, 180-to-520 px verse library, and long editor bodies may scroll internally; the page header, reserved error region, and footer remain fixed and horizontal scrolling is disabled
footer: reserved error region plus a separate fixed 56 px action-local feedback row outside the page scrollers; status and actions retain stable positions
event_list: one to five 54 px rows use natural bounded height; more rows scroll internally
verse_list: complete virtualized model in a viewport-derived 180-to-520 px bounded list with explicit semantic selection and vector-painted overflow action
editor_titles: event and verse editors use one native title only, are parented and window-modal, and stage Add event, Update event, Add verse, or Update verse into the global draft
save_close: stable Save changes label during saving; mutation controls and close are disabled; failures preserve the draft; dirty close offers Cancel, Discard changes, and Save and close with pending-close cleared on failure
capture_surface_verification: every PNG must sample-match the live Settings client so a same-sized Dashboard background cannot pass; all 12 page captures must use the complete decorated native Settings frame
release_blockers: macOS 100 percent application-font and Retina rendering
manual_acceptance_required: open from the Caleb M. menu in native macOS full-screen
open from the calendar gear in native macOS full-screen
resize the dialog without changing Spaces
switch all four navigation pages without changing Spaces
switch Events Active and Archived tabs without changing Spaces
edit an event without changing Spaces
edit a verse without changing Spaces
close and reopen without changing Spaces
repeat after a controlled Anki restart without changing Spaces
settings_profile_acceptance_gate: a structured exact-package macOS report must pass both full-screen opening paths with no desktop or Space switch; the 41 PNGs cannot satisfy or waive this gate
